batches.brief: Convert run_all.sh + etl/legacy-extra/crontab ordering (cron offsets */15, 5-59/15, 02:10 report, Sunday 06:00 chain) into Lakeflow Job ow_tp_custbill_job: tasks feed-load -> pipeline ow_tp_custbill_ldp -> report materialization with retries; schedule created PAUSED; serverless, warehouse 565cd2fd713738c4, never creates compute. Local plugin patches required BEFORE recon (apply to your session's plugin cache copy of skills/data-reconciliation/harness/recon/adapters.py): (1) in _uc_schema_facts change tp.grantee <> t.owner to tp.grantee <> t.table_owner (UC exposes table_owner); (2) inside _databricks_connect use sql.connect(server_hostname=host, http_path=http_path, access_token=_databricks_bearer()) for oauth-m2m (the connector's oauth_client_* kwargs drive interactive U2M and hang headless). Recon invocations: pass --target-http-path /sql/1.0/warehouses/565cd2fd713738c4 (the FULL warehouse path, not the bare id — bare id fails OpenSession). Override stale env DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH with that path for every recon and grants probe.
